notes: Static rich pack. State must stay short/front-loaded; option descriptions are matched against state.

genre.instructions: What genre of game best matches what is being requested?

criteria.arcade_shooter: fast paced shooting, dodging enemies, bullets and dodges
criteria.platformer: jumping between platforms, avoiding pits and obstacles
criteria.puzzle: logic, matching, sliding pieces, thinking over fast reactions
criteria.survival_roguelite: waves and runs that escalate, permadeath between runs
criteria.racing: driving, speed, tracks and lap timing
criteria.strategy: turn-based or real-time commanding units over a map
criteria.runner: endless forward motion, jump and slide over obstacles
criteria.tower_defense: placing defenses that stop marching enemies

camera_view.instructions: What camera perspective suits the game being described?

criteria.top_down: seen from above like Space Invaders or Binding of Isaac
criteria.side_scroller: viewed from the side, action moves left to right

visual_style.instructions: What visual art direction fits the request?

criteria.neon_vector: glowing wireframe shapes and trails on dark background
criteria.retro_pixel: chunky 8 or 16 bit pixel art sprites
criteria.flat_cartoon: simple flat colored shapes and characters
criteria.paper_cutout: layered flat paper look with soft shadows
criteria.minimal_monochrome: black and white minimal geometric shapes

palette.instructions: What color mood does the request suggest?

criteria.neon_dark: dark background with electric cyan magenta and lime accents
criteria.retro_warm: cream, orange, brown and deep red arcade warmth
criteria.cool_pastel: soft blues pinks and mint on light background
criteria.high_contrast_bw: pure black and white with single accent color
criteria.earthy_jewel: deep greens purples and gold jewel tones

control_scheme.instructions: What input scheme does the game need?

criteria.keyboard_only: arrow or WASD keys plus a couple action keys
criteria.mouse_aim: mouse aims or clicks, keyboard moves
criteria.keyboard_and_mouse: both keyboard movement and mouse aiming together
criteria.touch_friendly: pointer buttons or touch pads workable on a phone
criteria.gamepad_style: map like a gamepad with analog feel via keys

control_scheme.fallback: default to simple keyboard controls with mouse support

player_count.instructions: How many players does the request imply?

criteria.single_player: one person playing alone against the game
criteria.local_versus: two or more people sharing the same keyboard
criteria.asynchronous: one player competing against leaderboard times or scores

player_count.fallback: default to single player with score chasing

difficulty_curve.instructions: How should difficulty ramp during play?

criteria.steep_escalation: gets hard fast, intensity climbs quickly
criteria.constant_pressure: hard from the start and stays hard
criteria.player_paced: lets player choose difficulty level up front

difficulty_curve.fallback: default to gentle ramp with escalating late game

progression_system.instructions: What keeps the player coming back between runs?

criteria.pure_highscore: score chasing and personal bests only
criteria.meta_upgrades: permanent upgrades bought with earned currency
criteria.level_unlocks: discrete levels or stages that unlock in order
criteria.character_choices: unlockable characters or loadouts with different playstyles

progression_system.fallback: default to high score plus one unlock if easy

enemy_ai.instructions: What kind of enemy behavior is being asked for?

criteria.scripted_patterns: enemies follow fixed recognizable patterns and formations
criteria.simple_seeking: enemies steer toward or predict the player
criteria.swarm_chaos: many simple enemies creating emergent chaos
criteria.tactical: enemies use cover, flank, or coordinate attacks

enemy_ai.fallback: default to scripted patterns with slight seeking

boss_fight.instructions: Does the request ask for or imply a big boss encounter?

criteria.true: mentions boss, giant enemy, final confrontation, big bad
criteria.false: no boss mentioned, only regular enemies or none

physics_feel.instructions: What movement physics feel suits the request?

criteria.precise_tight: immediate response, stops on a dime, twitchy control
criteria.heavy_weighted: slow acceleration, real sense of mass

audio_style.instructions: What sound direction fits the mood of the request?

criteria.synth_arcade: chiptune bleeps and square wave melodies
criteria.ambient_minimal: sparse tones and soft effects, mostly quiet
criteria.rock_instrumental: drums and guitar energy generated procedurally

feedback_juice.instructions: How much polish and juice should effects convey?

criteria.moderate_juice: screen shake, particles on hits and pickups, subtle trails
criteria.maximum_juice: heavy shake, explosions, chromatic aberration, slowmo kill frames, pop numbers

persistence.instructions: What does the game need to remember between sessions?

criteria.full_progress: save unlocks, upgrades, settings, run history locally

session_length.instructions: What session length does the requested game suit?

criteria.short_burst: runs of one to three minutes, instant restart
criteria.medium: rounds of five to fifteen minutes
criteria.long_form: levels or campaigns strung into a longer arc

file_structure.instructions: What scale of implementation packaging fits the ask?

criteria.single_html: one self-contained html file, openable directly, no build
criteria.small_project: a few files with a lightweight engine or canvas helpers
criteria.full_project: multi-file project with bundler and asset pipeline

onscreen_hud.instructions: What does the heads up display need to show?

criteria.score_plus_stats: score, lives, level or wave, active powerups
criteria.rich_hud: score, health bar, combo meter, minimap or wave banner

failure_screen.instructions: What happens when the run ends?

criteria.game_over_summary: summary screen of stats then restart
criteria.run_recap_rewards: recap with earned upgrades you can apply
